subject: Difference on regression coefficients in lavaan vs Mplus and PROCESS - path analysis

messages.author: 0d7a04130df01d80
messages.subject: Difference on regression coefficients in lavaan vs Mplus and PROCESS - path analysis
parts:
Hello


I am doing path analysis in lavaan and the results I get slightly differ from those in Mplus or PROCESS in a way that the size of some of the coefficients but not all differs (e.g. coefficient between one of the predictors and  one of mediators are in R is  -.18 and in Mplus and Process is  -.16).


The model is fully saturated the level of significance for coefficients are the same. What is causing this difference, and should it be adressed?


Attached are the results from R and from Mplus (in PROCESS the results are the same as in Mplus).

Thank you.
Katica

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Difference on regression coefficients in lavaan vs Mplus and PROCESS - path analysis
parts:
There is a difference in syntax. The Mplus code says:

INCL with EXCL;

but the lavaan syntax says:

 INCL ~ EXCL    

Mplus allows for residual covariance , but lavaan is told to make EXCL a predictor of INCL, along with the other predictors--oddly, lavaan presents results for this last predictor of INCL differently.

Try changing the lavaan line to use ~~ (covariance) instead of ~ (regression), or change the Mplus syntax.
